lyrics.text: When the lights go down, we start to breathe.
Hold the first note, let it settle in the room.
Step by step, the rhythm carries every line.
Sing it clear, keep your eyes on the story.
Take it home with heart and harmony.
Midnight sky and a quiet street below.
Echoes of your voice begin to glow.
Every verse is floating in the dark.
Find the chorus, sing it from the heart.
Let it fade, but leave a little spark.
